title: Inclusion complexes of novel formyl chromone Schiff bases with beta-Cyclodextrin: Synthesis, characterization, DNA binding studies and in-vitro release study.
authors: Mansi; Khanna, Pankaj; Yadav, Shilpa; Singh, Asmita; Khanna, Leena
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成新型甲酰色酮席夫碱与β-环糊精包合物，通过分子对接和MD模拟研究其与ctDNA的沟槽结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作建模但对象为小分子-DNA体系，非TF-DNA，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: The present study involved the synthesis of five novel Schiff bases (SB1-SB5) of formyl chromone and their inclusion complexes with beta-cyclodextrin through kneading approach to enhance the solubility and stability of SBs. Characterization was conducted using FTIR, NMR, SEM, TEM, p-XRD, and Mass Spectrometry. UV fluorescence and pH stability studies confirmed the formation of the inclusion complex. Structural validation of complexes was conducted via molecular docking (PDB ID: 1BFN) and 50 ns MD simulation study. DFT studies were performed on SBs using B3LYP/6-31 + G(d,p) basis set. All SBs exhibited favorable ADME properties and high binding interactions were observed in molecular docking with ctDNA (PDB Id: 1BNA). Further, in-vitro UV absorption and fluorescence experiments demonstrated strong ctDNA interactions for all Schiff bases, with binding constants in the order of 10(5) M(-1), indicating groove binding mode. Among the SBs, SB4 exhibited the highest affinity for DNA grooves, with a binding constant (K(b)) of 1.7 x 10(6) M(-1). However, the SB4/beta-Cyd inclusion complex also interacted with DNA but with low binding constants compared to SB4. An in-vitro release study of SB4/beta-Cyd, revealed 78.92 % dissolution of the inclusion complex, highlighting its potential for enhanced solubility and stability in biological systems.
abstract_zh: 本研究合成了五种新型甲酰色酮席夫碱（SB1-SB5），并通过捏合方法制备了其与β-环糊精的包合物，以增强席夫碱的溶解性和稳定性。采用FTIR、NMR、SEM、TEM、p-XRD和质谱法进行表征。UV荧光和pH稳定性研究确认了包合物的形成。通过分子对接（PDB ID: 1BFN）和50 ns分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟研究对复合物进行了结构验证。使用B3LYP/6-31 + G(d,p)基组对席夫碱进行了DFT研究。所有席夫碱均表现出良好的ADME性质，并在与ctDNA（PDB Id: 1BNA）的分子对接中观察到高结合相互作用。此外，体外UV吸收和荧光实验表明，所有席夫碱均与ctDNA有强相互作用，结合常数在10(5) M(-1)数量级，表明为沟槽结合模式。在席夫碱中，SB4对DNA沟槽表现出最高亲和力，结合常数（K(b)）为1.7 x 10(6) M(-1)。然而，SB4/β-Cyd包合物也与DNA相互作用，但结合常数低于SB4。SB4/β-Cyd的体外释放研究显示，包合物的溶出度为78.92%，突显了其在生物系统中增强溶解性和稳定性的潜力。
